# Hookline: code map

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** A free LinkedIn writing studio: hooks that survive the see-more fold, posts in your own voice, a calm calendar and honest analytics. Optional AI.
**Live:** https://hookline.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/hookline · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `hookline/.claude/skills/hookline/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py hookline` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Engines stay JavaScript, moved unchanged** from the old `web/pages/_*.html`: `theme/assets/hl.js` (window.HL: post check, hook score, "see more" fold, formulas, structures, prompts, voice stats, feed card; a small shim at the top brings back the old `UI.fmtDate/ago/initials`), `hl-ai.js` (HL.ai: **bring-your-own-key Claude, browser → Anthropic directly; the key lives only in localStorage `hookline.ai`, never on our server: keep it that way, never log it**), `hl-media.js` (carousel canvas 1080×1350 + jsPDF, LinkedIn analytics XLSX reader + SVG line chart). Python reaches them only through `client_code/hl.py` (`HL.py.*` JSON text in/out; `hl.ai_call(name, ...)` passes ws/me as JS objects; streaming via an `on_text` Python callback).
- **Posting is button-only**: Studio → Dialogs/PostIt returns the chosen action; `li_post` / `hl.post_carousel` (confirm first, PDF made in the browser, `anvil.js.to_media`) run only after a press. Scheduling = a reminder (server task `send_reminders`), never auto-posting.
- **Workspace cache**: every member page calls `hl.load()` (`get_workspace`, one call); saves update it with `hl.put_post`. Studio autosaves with `window.setTimeout` (1.4 s; an Anvil Timer made in code never ticks) and saves on `leave()` (router calls `leave()` on the old page). New posts get their id via `router.replace`. Seeds from Ideas/Lab: `state.store_set("seed", {text, pillar, idea})`.
- **Items talk to their page** through `item["host"]` (Calendar days/posts/drafts, IdeaRow, Sample, PillarEdit, SlideEdit); PillarEdit/SlideEdit store themselves in `item["form"]` so the page reads/updates rows without redrawing (cursor stays). Calendar drag and drop = native DOM events on CalPost/CalDraft/CalDay with `host.drag_id`.
- **Grids made of panels**: the calendar grid (8 columns) is `weeks_panel` (role `contents`) → CalWeek host (`display: contents`) → `days_panel` → CalDay. Hosts that must vanish are listed in app.css (`.seg-host, .cw-host, .cd-host, .cp-host, .top-host`).
- **Server fix in the conversion**: `Studio.add_examples` counted nothing (`if app_tables.posts.search(...)`: a SearchIterator is always truthy, hosted Anvil too), so "Load example posts" never loaded; now `len(...)`.
- Design (facelift): eyebrows folded into headings/leads, radial hero glows and the calendar side-tab removed, feed placeholder stripes gone, the Ideas prompt card is fixed navy in both themes, `--c-faint`/`--c-accent` darkened to 4.5:1. Smoke test: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (tools/ui/smoke.js, 1280 + 390 px; the admin is arkulinskis@gmail.com, first sign-up becomes admin).
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Data tables (`anvil.yaml` db_schema)

- **app_settings**: key:str, value:obj · used in common
- **feedback**: user→users, name:str, email:str, kind:str, message:str, context:obj, status:str, note:str, created:dt · used in Feedback
- **ideas**: owner→users, text:str, kind:str, pillar:str, used:bool, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, DemoData, Studio
- **imports**: owner→users, kind:str, data:obj, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in DemoData, Insights, Studio
- **li_links**: user→users, sub:str, name:str, picture:str, token:str, expires_at:dt, state:str, state_at:dt, connected_at:dt · used in Admin, LinkedIn
- **posts**: owner→users, text:str, first_comment:str, pillar:str, format:str, status:str, scheduled_at:dt, posted_at:dt, url:str, li_urn:str, metrics:obj, carousel:obj, notes:str, reminded:bool, created:dt, updated:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, DemoData, Insights, LinkedIn, Studio
- **profiles**: user→users, voice:obj, pillars:obj, cadence:num, reminders:bool, timezone:str, starter:bool, updated:dt · used in DemoData, Studio
- **users**: email:str, enabled:bool, last_login:dt, password_hash:str, n_password_failures:num, confirmed_email:bool, signed_up:dt, display_name:str, is_admin:bool, is_demo:bool, last_seen:dt, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str · used in Admin, DemoData

## Biggest files (read these in parts)

`theme/assets/app.js` 2436, `theme/assets/app.css` 999, `anvil.yaml` 530, `client_code/Pages/Studio/__init__.py` 414, `theme/assets/hl.js` 355, `server_code/Studio.py` 348, `client_code/hl.py` 297, `client_code/Pages/Voice/__init__.py` 294

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
